arxiv-1806-04289.creator: Anton Dochtermann, Westin King
arxiv-1806-04289.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Anton Dochtermann, Westin King. Parking functions are a widely studied class of combinatorial objects, with connections to several branches of mathematics. On the algebraic side, parking functions can be identified with the standard monomials of M n M_{n} , a certain monomial ideal in the polynomial ring S = 𝕂 ⁡ [ x 1 , … , x n ] S={\mathbb{K}}[x_{1},\dots,x_{n}] where a set of generators are indexed by the nonempty subsets of [ n ] = { 1 , 2 , … ,

arxiv-2102-04465.title: Coadded Spectroscopic Stellar Parameters and Abundances from the LAMOST Low Resolution Survey
arxiv-2102-04465.creator: Jacob H. Hamer
arxiv-2102-04465.description: Abstract I combine duplicate spectroscopic stellar parameter estimates in the LAMOST Data Release 6 Low Resolution Spectral Survey A, F, G, and K Type stellar parameter catalog. Combining repeat measurements results in a factor of two improvement in the precision of the spectroscopic stellar parameter estimates. Moreover, this trivializes the process of performing coordinate-based cross-matching with other catalogs.

arxiv-2104-15124.title: Graph-theoretic algorithms for Kolmogorov operators: Approximating solutions and their gradients in elliptic and parabolic problems on manifolds
arxiv-2104-15124.creator: Andrew D. Davis, Dimitrios Giannakis
arxiv-2104-15124.description: Abstract We employ kernel-based approaches that use samples from a probability distribution to approximate a Kolmogorov operator on a manifold. The self-tuning variable-bandwidth kernel method [Berry & Harlim, Appl. Comput. Harmon. Anal. , 40(1):68–96, 2016] computes a large, sparse matrix that approximates the differential operator.

arxiv-2307-03225.title: On the maximum mass and oblateness of rotating neutron stars with generic equations of state
arxiv-2307-03225.creator: Carlo Musolino, Christian Ecker, Luciano Rezzolla
arxiv-2307-03225.description: Abstract A considerable effort has been dedicated recently to the construction of generic equations of state (EOSs) for matter in neutron stars. The advantage of these approaches is that they can provide model-independent information on the interior structure and global properties of neutron stars.

arxiv-2309-09203.title: Using Artificial Neural Networks to Determine Ontologies Most Relevant to Scientific Texts
arxiv-2309-09203.creator: Lukáš Korel, Alexander S. Behr, Norbert Kockmann, Martin Holeňa
arxiv-2309-09203.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lukáš Korel, Alexander S. Behr, Norbert Kockmann, Martin Holeňa. Abstrakt This paper provides an insight into the possibility of how to find ontologies most relevant to scientific texts using artificial neural networks. The basic idea of the presented approach is to select a representative paragraph from a source text file, embed it to a vector space by a pre-trained fine-tuned transformer, and classify the embedded vector according to its relevance to a target ontology.

arxiv-2312-02620.title: On the combinatorics of r r -chain minimal and maximal excludants Thanks: 2020 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. Primary 05A17, 11P84, 05A19; Secondary 11P81. Keywords and phrases. Minimal excludant, maximal excludant, r r -chain minimal excludants, r r -chain maximal excludants, partition id
arxiv-2312-02620.creator: Subhash Chand Bhoria, Pramod Eyyunni, Runqiao Li
arxiv-2312-02620.description: Abstract . The minimal excludant (mex) of a partition was introduced by Grabner and Knopfmacher under the name ‘least gap’ and was revived by a couple of papers due to Andrews and Newman. It has been widely studied in recent years together with the complementary partition statistic maximal excludant (maex), first introduced by Chern.

arxiv-2402-14465.title: Lightlike conformal reduction of 6d ( 1 , 0 ) (1,0) theories
arxiv-2402-14465.description: Abstract We study 6d ( 1 , 0 ) (1,0) superconformal theories. These have a natural lightlike conformal Killing vector, the Dirac current. We perform a conformal dimensional reduction along the Dirac current down to five-dimensions in such a way that we always preserve at least two real supercharges.

arxiv-2409-04997.title: Thermodynamic topology of Black Holes in F ⁡ ( R ) F(R) -Euler-Heisenberg gravity’s Rainbow
arxiv-2409-04997.creator: Yassine Sekhmani, Saeed Noori Gashti, Mohammad Ali S. Afshar, Mohammad Reza Alipour, Jafar Sadeghi, Behnam Pourhassan, Javlon Rayimbaev
arxiv-2409-04997.description: Abstract The topology of black hole thermodynamics is a fascinating area of study that explores the connections between thermodynamic properties and topological features of black holes. It often involves analyzing critical points in the phase diagrams of black holes and assigning topological charges to these points.

arxiv-2508-00481.title: Search for dynamical black hole captures enhanced with Gaussian mixture modeling
arxiv-2508-00481.creator: Leigh Smith, Shubhanshu Tiwari, Michael Ebersold, Yeong-Bok Bae, Gungwon Kang, Ik Siong Heng
arxiv-2508-00481.description: Abstract Gravitational waves (GWs) are expected to originate from black holes interacting dynamically in dense astrophysical environments. In such environments, given that the velocity and cross section between the interacting black holes is low, dynamical capture may occur. Such events merge on very short timescales with high eccentricities and are expected to be detectable in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) sensitivity band.

arxiv-2511-16170.title: Target Refocusing via Attention Redistribution for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation: An Explainability Perspective
arxiv-2511-16170.creator: Jiahao Li, Yang Lu, Yachao Zhang, Yong Xie, Fangyong Wang, Yuan Xie, Yanyun Qu
arxiv-2511-16170.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) employs pixel-level vision-language alignment to associate category-related prompts with corresponding pixels. A key challenge is enhancing the multimodal dense prediction capability, specifically this pixel-level multimodal alignment. Although existing methods achieve promising results by leveraging CLIP’s vision-language alignment, they rarely investigate the performance boundaries of CLIP for dense prediction from an interpretability mechanisms perspective.

arxiv-2512-04422.title: The Dirichlet heat trace for domains with curved corners
arxiv-2512-04422.creator: Shi-Zhuo Looi, David Sher
arxiv-2512-04422.description: Abstract . We study the short-time asymptotics of the Dirichlet heat trace on planar curvilinear polygons. For such domains we show that the coefficient of t 1 / 2 t^{1/2} in the expansion splits into a boundary integral of κ 2 \kappa^{2} and a sum of local corner contributions, one for each vertex.

arxiv-2602-17714.title: Analysis Of A Long Memory Circular Convolution Model
arxiv-2602-17714.creator: Robert Kimberk
arxiv-2602-17714.description: Abstract . A stochastic model, the product of a circulant matrix and a random normal vector, is shown to produce an evolutive long memory time series with a power law spectral density. The distribution of the time series, a beta location scale family of distributions, yields a connection to the unit centered spherical distribution and directional statistics.

arxiv-2603-16244.creator: Song Tae-Eun

lie-family-at-gilje-eastman-1920.creator: Jonas Lie
lie-family-at-gilje-eastman-1920.description: Jonas Lie's beloved domestic novel of a Norwegian officer's family in the 1840s, translated by Samuel Coffin Eastman for the American-Scandinavian Foundation's Scandinavian Classics (1920).

plos-pone-0004088.title: Gap Junction Mediated Intercellular Metabolite Transfer in the Cochlea Is Compromised in Connexin30 Null Mice
plos-pone-0004088.creator: Qing Chang, Wenxue Tang, Shoeb Ahmad et al.
plos-pone-0004088.description: PLOS ONE research article. Connexin26 (Cx26) and connexin30 (Cx30) are two major protein subunits that co-assemble to form gap junctions (GJs) in the cochlea. Mutations in either one of them are the major cause of non-syndromic prelingual deafness in humans. Because the mechanisms of cochlear pathogenesis

pmc-10520889.title: AKIR-1 regulates proteasome subcellular function in Caenorhabditis elegans
pmc-10520889.creator: Johanna Pispa, Elisa Mikkonen, Leena Arpalahti, Congyu Jin, Carmen Martínez-Fernández, Julián Cerón, Carina I. Holmberg
pmc-10520889.description: SummaryPolyubiquitinated proteins are primarily degraded by the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS). Proteasomes are present both in the cytoplasm and nucleus. Here, we investigated mechanisms coordinating proteasome subcellular localization and activity in a multicellular organism. We identified the nuclear protein-encoding gene akir-1 as a proteasome regulator in a genome-wide Caenorhabditis elegans RNAi screen.

pmc-10750080.title: Progress of near-infrared-II fluorescence in precision diagnosis and treatment of colorectal cancer
pmc-10750080.creator: Yong Wu, Hongtao Cao, Shaoqing Yang, Chaohui Liu, Zhenguo Han
pmc-10750080.description: Colorectal cancer is a malignant tumour with high incidence and mortality worldwide; therefore, improving the early diagnosis of colorectal cancer and implementing a targeted "individualized treatment" strategy is of great concern. NIR-II fluorescence imaging is a large-depth, high-resolution optical bioimaging tool.

pmc-11356924.title: Effect of the Addition of Inorganic Fillers on the Properties of Degradable Polymeric Blends for Bone Tissue Engineering
pmc-11356924.creator: Stanisław Marecik, Iwona Pudełko-Prażuch, Mareeswari Balasubramanian, Sundara Moorthi Ganesan, Suvro Chatterjee, Kinga Pielichowska, Ravichandran Kandaswamy, Elżbieta Pamuła, Jianxun Ding
pmc-11356924.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Bone tissue exhibits self-healing properties; however, not all defects can be repaired without surgical intervention. Bone tissue engineering offers artificial scaffolds, which can act as a temporary matrix for bone regeneration. The aim of this study was to manufacture scaffolds made of poly(lactic acid), poly(ε-caprolactone), poly(propylene fumarate), and poly(ethylene glycol) modified with bioglass, beta tricalcium phosphate (TCP), and/or wollastonite (W) particles. The scaffolds were fabricated using a gel-casting method and observed with optical and scanning electron microscopes.

pmc-11490259.title: Comparative Analysis of Intravitreal Dexamethasone Implant (Ozurdex) and Brolucizumab Injection in the Treatment of Diabetic Macular Edema with Hyperreflective Intraretinal Dots: A Retrospective Study
pmc-11490259.creator: Somnath Chakraborty, Jay Umed Sheth
pmc-11490259.description: PurposeThis retrospective study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of intravitreal Dexamethasone Implant (DEX) and Brolucizumab Injection in treating Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) with Hyperreflective Intraretinal Dots (HRID).Patients and MethodsA single-center retrospective study in India included 40 eyes (20 per group) with controlled diabetes and HRID on optical coherence tomography.

pmc-12419130.title: Successful Transition From Covert, Involuntary Oral Medication to Consensual, Long-Acting, Injectable Antipsychotic Therapy in a Patient With Schizophrenia: A Case Report From Japan
pmc-12419130.creator: Yoshiyo Oguchi, Nobumi Miyake
pmc-12419130.description: Medication non-adherence is a primary obstacle in schizophrenia management, often leading to the involuntary or covert administration of medication by caregivers. Covert medication, the practice of administering medicine to a person without their knowledge, occurs in Japan within a complex ethical and legal landscape that lacks clear institutional frameworks, posing significant dilemmas for patients, their families, and clinicians.

pmc-12613307.title: Synthesis of novel pyrazole derivatives and neuroprotective effect investigation
pmc-12613307.creator: Aihua Feng, Qing Zeng, Jun Wang, Han Li, Xu Fang, Yan Geng, Wei Pan, Gang Li, Junfeng Dong
pmc-12613307.description: Spinal cord injuries (SCIs) cause irreversible damage and lasting neurological impairments. Current treatments are limited to surgical and pharmaceutical interventions, underscoring the need for novel agents. In this study, 27 novel pyrazole derivatives were designed, synthesised. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities of the compounds were systematically evaluated utilising lipopolysaccharide-stimulated BV2 microglial cells.

pmc-12615495.title: Simultaneous and sensitive detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and SARS-CoV-2 antigens employing an electrochemical impedance spectroscopy aptasensor
pmc-12615495.creator: Zhazira Zhumabekova, Timur Elebessov, Tri Thanh Pham, Damira Kanayeva
pmc-12615495.description: MPT64 and S-glycoprotein are essential biomarkers for detecting tuberculosis and coronavirus, two prevalent infectious diseases worldwide. In this study, we developed an electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)-based aptasensor fabricated to detect both target antigens simultaneously, employing a dual-platform approach on a screen-printed gold electrode (SPGE).

pmc-12656872.title: Mapping Eight Decades of Vaccination Social Science: Bibliometric Analysis of Global Research Trends
pmc-12656872.creator: Chinwe Iwu-Jaja, Oluwatosin Nkereuwem, Chidozie D. Iwu, Akhona V. Mazingisa, Anelisa Jaca, Duduzile Ndwandwe, Charles S. Wiysonge
pmc-12656872.description: Background: Despite growing recognition of vaccination social science as essential to immunization strategies, the field’s evolution, geographic distribution, and research patterns remain poorly characterized. This study provides the first comprehensive mapping of the social science literature on vaccination over eight decades.

pmc-12663645.title: Management of periprosthetic proximal femoral fracture of megaprosthesis with limited residual bone stock: A case report
pmc-12663645.creator: Muhamad Naseh Sajadi Budi, Bangkit Primayudha, Mohammad Syarif Mas'ud, Greesea Dinamaria Whitiana, Andre Prawiradinata
pmc-12663645.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionPeriprosthetic fractures involving femoral megaprostheses are complex and challenging to manage due to limited residual bone stock available for fixation. In Indonesia, data on such complications are scarce, and surgical strategies often require adaptation based on resource availability.Case presentationA 42-year-old man with a history of distal femoral megaprosthesis implantation for a giant cell tumor presented with right hip pain after a low-energy fall. Imaging showed a Vancouver type B3 periprosthetic fracture.

pmc-13116304.title: Diagnostic Performance of Blood-Based Inflammatory Indices, Including a Novel Composite Score, for Estimating Fecal Calprotectin Levels in Pediatric Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-13116304.creator: Abdulkerim Elmas, Mustafa Akçam
pmc-13116304.description: Objectives: To evaluate the association between fecal calprotectin (FC) levels and routinely available blood-based inflammatory indices measured during the same clinical episode in pediatric patients, as well as to assess the diagnostic performance of a novel composite parameter, the Gastrointestinal Inflammation Index (GII).

pmc-13178410.title: A dermoid cyst in the fourth ventricle of an adult patient: a case description emphasizing diagnostic challenges and surgical management
pmc-13178410.creator: Yan Wang, Ming Liu, Zhengdi Wang, Menglei Fan, Yu Ran, Qunwu Li
pmc-13178410.description: ydrocephalus and chemical meningitis (2). Thus, early, accurate diagnosis and surgical intervention are essential in clinical practice. We present an exceptionally rare case of a fourth ventricular dermoid cyst initially misdiagnosed as an astrocytoma. Through retrospective analysis integrating preoperative imaging features with histopathological findings, this study systematically examined the diagnostic challenges of lipid-deficient dermoid cysts in the fourth ventricle.

pmc-13188978.title: From magma ocean to core–mantle boundary: the key role of hydrous ferropericlase in shaping deep Earth’s low-velocity anomalies
pmc-13188978.creator: Shi-Dong Guan, Yu Wang, Zhi-Xue Du, Ya-Nan Yang, Yi-Gang Xu
pmc-13188978.description: HPHT experiments assisted with NanoSIMS demonstrate that hydrous ferropericlase, stable in the early basal magma ocean, is an efficient water reservoir and may provide a new explanation for the origin of Earth's deep low-velocity anomalies. Water is essential for Earth’s habitability, with its influence extending far beyond the surface to the planet’s deep interior.

pmc-13217045.title: Systolic blood pressure within 24 hours after successful reperfusion correlates with outcomes in acute ischemic stroke: a secondary analysis of the EHCHANTED2/MT Trial
pmc-13217045.creator: Yifeng Liu, Xuan Zhu, Donghuan Zhang, Zhaoshuo Li, Gaoqi Zhang, Haocun Zheng, Duanyun Lan, Hao Qin, Hongjian Shen, Pengfei Xing, Pengfei Yang, Lei Zhang, Yongwei Zhang, Xiaoxi Zhang, Xiaofei Ye, Changming Wen, Hailong Zhong, Jianmin Liu, on behalf of the ENCHANTED2/MT Investigators
pmc-13217045.description: BackgroundThe optimal threshold or range for systolic blood pressure (SBP) control in patients with successful reperfusion after endovascular thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke (AIS) remains undefined. This study investigated whether SBP within the first 24 hours after successful reperfusion correlates with functional outcomes in AIS.

pmc-13592065.title: Observations-Based Approach to the Estimation of the Oxidizing Capacity of the Atmosphere of Central London over the 2000–2024 Period
pmc-13592065.creator: M. Anwar H. Khan, Richard G. Derwent, Frank A. F. Winiberg, Carl J. Percival, Dudley E. Shallcross
pmc-13592065.description: An observations-based approach has been applied to the air quality monitoring data at the London Marylebone Road over the 2000–2024 study period to estimate the oxidizing capacity of the atmosphere in Central London. The mean of the daylight hours-averaged OH number densities is found to be 4.
